correctness.rationale: After the exact linear coordinate change a=X−Y, b=W−Z, u=X, v=W in characteristic three, the defining quartic becomes ua³−vb³. Being primitive of degree one in u,v with coprime a³,b³, it is geometrically irreducible. The Jacobian subscheme is (a³,b³) on the hypersurface; its reduction is the codimension-one line L={a=b=0} and its generic transverse artin length is 9, proving nonnormality by Serre R1. The incidence ruled surface ta−sb=s³u−t³v=0 in P1×P3 is P(O(-1)⊕O(-3))≅F2. Projection is an isomorphism away from L, finite by proper/quasi-finite fibers, birational and normal source; over L it is the relative cube Frobenius P1→P1, radicial and surjective. Thus it is normalization and universal homeomorphism. Any line M with the restrictions of (a,b) of rank 0 is L; rank 1 forces the corresponding ruling line; rank 2 forces u=v=0 by the identity αs⁴+βs³t−γst³−δt⁴=0, hence M=L0. This exhaustive classification yields q+1 ruling lines plus two directrices (q+3 total) over any F_{3^m}. Frobenius on the singular directrix is bijective on finite-field points, so #S(Fq)=(q+1)² and the zeta function is 1/[(1−T)(1−qT)²(1−q²T)]. Inspected the exact finite field verifier code; its independent polynomial-on-line containment, unlike pointwise F3 vanishing, confirms 16,100,784 rational points and 6,12 lines for q=3,9.

originality.rationale: Rams–Schütt explicitly distinguish Schur’s smooth good-reduction model in characteristic three, isomorphic to a Fermat quartic with 112 lines, from coefficientwise reduction of the specific displayed integral Schur equation. The latter is singular and inseparably normalized, so smooth K3 line theorems do not imply its F2 normalization or q+3 lines. Veniani studies smooth complex quartic equations; González-Alonso–Rams treat complex ruled/quartic line bounds. The full characteristic-three Frobenius normalization and zeta formula survive comparison, albeit the model belongs to classical ruled-surface geometry; unindexed older positive-characteristic scroll descriptions remain a priority risk.

Its degree-three radicial directrix is a meaningful pathology with an exact zeta consequence, beyond a finite example.
